6057-fran.creator: Unknown
6057-fran.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. t the stranger with surprise which was, in itself, reproof. Standing in the dim light that reached the porch from the hall, Fran's appearance was not above suspicion. She looked very dark, sharp-faced, and small. Her attitude suggested one who wanted something and had come to ask for it.

arxiv-1911-07434.title: Ultra-Fast Accurate AoA Estimation via Automotive Massive-MIMO Radar
arxiv-1911-07434.creator: Bin Li, Shusen Wang, Jun Zhang, Xianbin Cao, Chenglin Zhao
arxiv-1911-07434.description: Abstract Massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar, enabled by millimeter-wave virtual MIMO techniques, provides great promises to the high-resolution automotive sensing and target detection in unmanned ground/aerial vehicles (UGA/UAV). As a long-established problem, however, existing subspace methods suffer from either high complexity or low accuracy.

arxiv-2102-10857.title: Dimensional analysis and the correspondence between classical and quantum uncertainty
arxiv-2102-10857.creator: V Gattus, S Karamitsos
arxiv-2102-10857.description: Abstract Heisenberg’s uncertainty principle is often cited as an example of a “purely quantum” relation with no analogue in the classical limit where ℏ → 0 \hbar\to 0 . However, this formulation of the classical limit is problematic for many reasons, one of which is dimensional analysis.

arxiv-2105-13842.title: Ribaucour partial tubes and hypersurfaces of Enneper type
arxiv-2105-13842.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by . In this article we introduce the notion of a Ribaucour partial tube and use it to derive several applications. These are based on a characterization of Ribaucour partial tubes as the immersions of a product of two manifolds into a space form such that the distributions given by the tangent spaces of the factors are orthogonal to each other with respect to the induced metric, are invariant under all shape operators, and one of them is spherical.

arxiv-2109-03731.title: Cross-Policy Compliance Detection via Question Answering
arxiv-2109-03731.creator: Marzieh Saeidi, Majid Yazdani, Andreas Vlachos
arxiv-2109-03731.description: Abstract Policy compliance detection is the task of ensuring that a scenario conforms to a policy (e.g. a claim is valid according to government rules or a post in an online platform conforms to community guidelines). This task has been previously instantiated as a form of textual entailment, which results in poor accuracy due to the complexity of the policies.

arxiv-2205-10826.title: Two disjoint cycles in digraphs
arxiv-2205-10826.creator: Mikołaj Lewandowski, Joanna Polcyn, Christian Reiher
arxiv-2205-10826.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mikołaj Lewandowski, Joanna Polcyn, Christian Reiher. Bermond and Thomassen conjectured that every digraph with minimum outdegree at least 2 ​ k − 1 2k-1 contains k k vertex disjoint cycles. So far the conjecture was verified for k ≤ 3 k\leq 3 . Here we generalise the question asking for all outdegree sequences which force k k vertex disjoint cycles and give the full answer for k ≤ 2 k\leq 2 . 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification
Primary: 05C35.

arxiv-2206-10559.title: Low Resource Pipeline for Spoken Language Understanding via Weak Supervision
arxiv-2206-10559.creator: Ayush Kumar, Rishabh Kumar Tripathi, Jithendra Vepa
arxiv-2206-10559.description: Abstract In Weak Supervised Learning (WSL), a model is trained over noisy labels obtained from semantic rules and task-specific pre-trained models. Rules offer limited generalization over tasks and require significant manual efforts while pre-trained models are available only for limited tasks.

arxiv-2207-02764.title: Enhancing Adversarial Attacks on Single-Layer NVM Crossbar-Based Neural Networks with Power Consumption Information
arxiv-2207-02764.creator: Cory Merkel
arxiv-2207-02764.description: Abstract Adversarial attacks on state-of-the-art machine learning models pose a significant threat to the safety and security of mission-critical autonomous systems. This paper considers the additional vulnerability of machine learning models when attackers can measure the power consumption of their underlying hardware platform.

arxiv-2207-14011.title: Marvel DC: A Blockchain-Based Decentralized and Incentive-Compatible Distributed Computing Protocol Note: This document is part of a project that has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under grant agreement number 814284 Journal: Journal of Info
arxiv-2207-14011.creator: Conor McMenamin, Vanesa Daza
arxiv-2207-14011.description: Abstract 1 Abstract Decentralized computation outsourcing should allow anyone to access the large amounts of computational power that exists in the Internet of Things. Unfortunately, when trusted third parties are removed to achieve this decentralization, ensuring an outsourced computation is performed correctly remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we provide a solution to this problem.

arxiv-2301-05195.title: A numerical study of measurement-induced phase transitions in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model
arxiv-2301-05195.creator: Stav Haldar, Anthony J. Brady
arxiv-2301-05195.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Stav Haldar, Anthony J. Brady. Continuous monitoring of an otherwise closed quantum system has been found to lead to a measurement-induced phase transition (MIPT) characterized by abrupt changes in the entanglement or purity of the many-body quantum state. For an entanglement MIPT, entangling dynamics compete with measurement dynamics, pushing the system either to a phase with extensive entanglement or to a phase with low-level entanglement.

arxiv-2306-12101.title: Generation of high circular polarization of interstellar Lyman α \alpha radiation triggering biological homochirality 2019 Generation of high circular polarization of interstellar Lyman α \alpha radiation triggering biological homochirality – C
arxiv-2306-12101.creator: Hajime Fukushima, Hidenobu Yajima, Masayuki Umemura
arxiv-2306-12101.description: Abstract The homochirality of biological molecules on the Earth is a long-standing mystery regarding the origin of life. Circularly polarized ultraviolet (UV) light could induce the enantiomeric excess of biological molecules in the interstellar medium, leading to the homochirality on the earth.

arxiv-2307-10124.title: COMPUTING MIXED MULTIPLICITIES, MIXED VOLUMES AND SECTIONAL MILNOR NUMBERS Thanks: 2020 AMS Mathematics Subject Classification: Primary 13-04, 13A30, 13H15. Thanks: Key words : Multi-Rees algebras, mixed multiplicities, sectional Milnor numbers, mixed volume
arxiv-2307-10124.creator: Kriti Goel, Vivek Mukundan, Sudeshna Roy, J. K. Verma
arxiv-2307-10124.description: Abstract . This is an expository version of our paper [ 9 ] . Our aim is to present recent Macaulay2 algorithms for computation of mixed multiplicities of ideals in a Noetherian ring which is either local or a standard graded algebra over a ﬁeld.

arxiv-2311-06773.title: Sublattice scars and beyond in two-dimensional U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) quantum link lattice gauge theories
arxiv-2311-06773.creator: Indrajit Sau, Paolo Stornati, Debasish Banerjee, Arnab Sen
arxiv-2311-06773.description: Abstract In this article, we elucidate the structure and properties of a class of anomalous high-energy states of matter-free U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) quantum link gauge theory Hamiltonians using numerical and analytical methods. Such anomalous states, known as quantum many-body scars in the literature, have generated a lot of interest due to their athermal nature.

arxiv-2312-09740.title: VITA: A Multi-modal LLM-based System for Longitudinal, Autonomous, and Adaptive Robotic Mental Well-being Coaching DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation emai; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY Woodstock ’18: ACM Symposium on Neur
arxiv-2312-09740.creator: Micol Spitale, Minja Axelsson, Hatice Gunes
arxiv-2312-09740.description: Abstract . Recently, several works have explored if and how robotic coaches can promote and maintain mental well-being in different settings. However, findings from these studies revealed that these robotic coaches are not ready to be used and deployed in real-world settings due to several limitations that span from technological challenges to coaching success.

arxiv-2401-10015.title: Towards Hierarchical Spoken Language Disfluency Modeling
arxiv-2401-10015.creator: Jiachen Lian, Gopala Anumanchipalli
arxiv-2401-10015.description: Abstract Speech disfluency modeling is the bottleneck for both speech therapy and language learning. However, there is no effective AI solution to systematically tackle this problem. We solidify the concept of disfluent speech and disfluent speech modeling . We then present Hierarchical Unconstrained Disfluency Modeling (H-UDM) approach, the hierarchical extension of Lian et al.

arxiv-2407-03242.title: Quantum Curved Tetrahedron, Quantum Group Intertwiner Space, and Coherent States
arxiv-2407-03242.creator: Chen-Hung Hsiao, Qiaoyin Pan
arxiv-2407-03242.description: Abstract In this paper, we construct the phase space of a constantly curved tetrahedron with fixed triangle areas in terms of a pair of Darboux coordinates called the length and twist coordinates, which are in analogy to the Fenchel-Nielsen coordinates for flat connections, and their quantization.

pmc-10656757.title: Mycophenolate mofetil versus cyclophosphamide plus in patients with connective tissue disease-associated interstitial lung disease: Efficacy and safety analysis
pmc-10656757.creator: Pengfei Wang, Li Zhang, Qian Guo, Lifen Zhao, Yanyan Hao
pmc-10656757.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The decision for definitive therapy for the treatment of patients with connective tissue disease-associated interstitial lung disease (CTD-ILD) is difficult. Patients with CTD-ILD received 0.5 g twice a day of mycophenolate mofetil for 2 years (MMF cohort, n = 105) or cyclophosphamide 50 mg once every other day, and the cumulative dose of cyclophosphamide should not exceed 10 g (CYC cohort, n = 140).

pmc-10694131.title: Structure-based identification of novel inhibitors targeting the enoyl-ACP reductase enzyme of Acinetobacter baumannii
pmc-10694131.creator: Shama Khan, Shabir A. Madhi, Courtney Olwagen
pmc-10694131.description: Acinetobacter baumannii is a Gram-negative multidrug-resistant bacterial pathogen primarily associated with nosocomial infections resulting in increased morbidity and mortality in adults and infants, especially in sub-Saharan Africa where the clinical burden is high. New therapeutics are needed to treat multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii infections and reduce transmission.

pmc-10703859.title: Development and validation of machine learning based prediction model for postoperative pain risk after extraction of impacted mandibular third molars
pmc-10703859.creator: Dongsheng Yu, Zifeng Liu, Weijie Zhuang, Kechen Li, Yaxin Lu
pmc-10703859.description: BackgroundPredicting postoperative pain risk in patients with impacted mandibular third molar extractions is helpful in guiding clinical decision-making, enhancing perioperative pain management, and improving the patients’ medical experience. This study aims to develop a prediction model based on machine learning algorithms to identify patients at high risk of postoperative pain after tooth extraction.MethodsWe conducted a prospective cohort study.

pmc-10712071.title: Positive outcomes following Autologous Matrix-Induced Chondrogenesis (AMIC) in the treatment of retropatellar chondral lesions: a retrospective analysis of a patient registry
pmc-10712071.creator: J Gille, E Reiss, P Behrens, R P Jakob, T Piontek
pmc-10712071.description: BackgroundThe patellofemoral joint is a challenging environment for treating chondral defects. Among the surgical options for the treatment of chondral defects, the single-stage Autologous Matrix-Induced Chondrogenesis (AMIC) procedure uses a porcine collagen I/III membrane to enhance bone-marrow stimulation. However, longer term outcomes data are rare for this specific indication.

pmc-11333347.title: Synergistic combination of baicalein and rifampicin against Staphylococcus aureus biofilms
pmc-11333347.creator: Rajeshwari Muniyasamy, I. Manjubala
pmc-11333347.description: Staphylococcus aureus, a Gram-positive bacterium, is a predominant pathogen associated with various infections. The rapid emergence of antibiotic resistance has intensified the challenge of managing fracture-related infections in severe osteoporotic patients. Rifampicin, a potent antimicrobial agent employed against fracture and implant-related infections, necessitates combination therapies due to its susceptibility to antibiotic resistance.

pmc-11603808.title: What does it cost to deliver antenatal care in Papua New Guinea? Results from a health system costing and budget impact analysis using cross-sectional data
pmc-11603808.creator: Olga Phoebe Martinella Saweri, Neha Batura, William Pomat, Andrew John Vallely, Virginia Wiseman, WANTAIM Study Group
pmc-11603808.description: AbstractObjectiveIn Papua New Guinea (PNG), antenatal clinic attendance averaged 50% for one or more visits, and 30% for four visits in the last decade. In 2016, the WHO revised its focused antenatal care (ANC) model recommending eight rather than four visits. If implemented, this new model would require additional resources.

pmc-11679874.title: Relaxation Phenomena in Low-Density and High-Density Polyethylene
pmc-11679874.creator: Viktor A Lomovskoy, Svetlana A Shatokhina, Fahmi Zaïri
pmc-11679874.description: A study was conducted on the internal friction spectra and temperature dependencies of the frequency of free damped oscillatory processes excited in the investigated samples of low-density polyethylene (LDPE) and high-density polyethylene (HDPE) over a temperature range from −150 °C to +150 °C.

pmc-12365013.title: The role of personality traits in predicting educational use of generative AI in higher education
pmc-12365013.creator: Ibrahim Arpaci, Ismail Kuşci, Omer Gibreel
pmc-12365013.description: Generative Artificial Intelligence (Gen-AI) systems offer significant opportunities for personalized learning in higher education. Studying the effects of personality traits on the use of Gen-AI is crucial for understanding the role of individual differences in integrating this innovative technology into education.

pmc-12506935.title: Ligand-receptor interactions induce and mediate regulatory functions of BATF3+ B cells
pmc-12506935.creator: Hui Yan, Rui Wang, Suryavathi Viswanadhapalli, Christian Cervantes, Funan He, Shuai Wu, Azad Khosh, Weiwei Luo, Jingwei Wang, Maria J. Fernandez, Uday P. Pratap, Mustafa Khan, Karli Hinton, Sai Eashan Vankamamidi, Dariela Perez, Carlos E. Rivera, Harshita B. Gupta, Fushun Zhang, Zhenqing Ye, Yidong
pmc-12506935.description: B cells express many protein ligands, yet their regulatory functions are incompletely understood. We profiled ligand expression across murine B sublineage cells, including those activated by defined receptor signals, and assessed their regulatory capacities and specificities through in silico analysis of ligand-receptor interactions. Consequently, we identified a B cell subset that expressed cytokine interleukin-27 (IL-27) and chemokine CXCL10.

pmc-12969886.title: Modulation of the nutritional, metabolomic and microRNA profile of colostrum and piglet performance via a high-energy, high-lysine transition diet in sows
pmc-12969886.creator: Diana Luise, Silvia Bencivenni, Antonio Zurru, Andrea Serra, Luca Laghi, Federico Correa, Francesco Palumbo, Paolo Trevisi
pmc-12969886.description: BackgroundThe transition period is a critical phase for the sow due to physiological changes and nutritional requirements. A diet balanced in energy and amino acid (AA) content could improve reproductive performance, colostrum quality and piglets' growth. This study evaluated the efficacy of a transition diet (TRT) with higher energy (12.97 MJ/kg of metabolizable energy (ME)) and SID lysine (Lys; 0.

pmc-13152935.title: Complete genome and phylogenetic characterization of a novel papillomavirus from Cuniculus paca in the Brazilian Amazon
pmc-13152935.creator: Cleyton Silva de Araújo, Laura Gabrielly Alves Henrique, Hanna Gabriela da Silva Oliveira, Jhonatan Henrique Lima da Rocha, Junio Damasceno de Souza¹, Agnes de Souza Lima, Vania Maria França Ribeiro, Francisco Carlos da Silva, David Driemeier, Cláudio Wageck Canal, John Munday, Felipe Masiero Salvar
pmc-13152935.description: Wild rodents remain underrepresented in papillomavirus genomics, limiting current understanding of host range, tissue tropism, and evolutionary diversity. Here, we report the first papillomavirus identified in the spotted lowland paca, Cuniculus paca, from the Brazilian Amazon, provisionally designated Cuniculus paca papillomavirus 1 (CpPV1). Histopathological examination supported the diagnosis of a virally induced squamous papilloma.

pmc-13575882.title: Evaluation of the Therapeutic Potential of Natural Peptides Against Hemagglutinin–Esterase of Bovine Coronavirus Based on Molecular Dynamics Simulation Studies
pmc-13575882.creator: Mohammed Adnan Hashim Al-battat, Marzieh Gharouni, Mohammadreza Nassiri, Ali Javadmanesh, Ahmad Asoodeh, Reza Tohidi
pmc-13575882.description: The hemagglutinin–esterase (HE) protein of bovine coronavirus is required for virus attachment and entry into host cells. It is thus an attractive target for the development of peptide‐based antiviral agents. In the present study, molecular docking was performed to identify bioactive peptides with high binding potential toward the HE protein, followed by molecular dynamics (MD) simulations.
